MIGRATION_HANDOFF: Phase 4 batch 2+ resume

A session handoff document is now committed at `docs/handoff/closure-checks-migration-batch-2.md`. It contains:

- Full list of the 13 epics processed in session 1 (do not re-classify).
- Full list of the 57 epics still pending (process these in future batches, ~25 acks per session per DD5).
- The Claude-orchestrator driver script for plan-mode batches.
- The plan/apply flow for the Claude-driven ack mechanism.
- Per-item ack heuristics learned from session 1 (which patterns the user accepted vs rejected).
- Pointers to commits, contracts, scripts, and tests.

To resume: in a fresh session, read the handoff doc, paste the next 10-20 epic IDs into the driver script (one batch worth), invoke the plan-mode batch, ack items via AskUserQuestion, then apply.

Reference commit landing the handoff: see worktree-20260520-153616 branch (this session's branch).
